propositions: Detached pytest runs via nohup report failures that do not reproduce in foreground runs, causing false-positive regressions and wasted investigation
The root cause is external concurrent mutation of the shared checkout by another process, not detachment itself — detachment only enables such mutation because foreground runs block the agent
The _no_repo_root_leaks guard cannot distinguish in-test mutations from concurrent external writes and misattributes them to innocent tests, additionally deleting external files
The e2e browser probe failure diagnostic reports empty stderr from signal-killed children without inspecting returncode, making signal death indistinguishable from product failure
Documentation of trusted local validation methods (detached vs serial, worktree isolation, pytest-xdist configuration) is entirely absent despite detached-suite practice being routine folklore
